draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for raising the weekly summary email -- as I mentioned, it isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and I've passed your interest along. That ticket is closed on our side, so just say the word if anything's still open there.

You've got your first project set up, which is the main thing -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Wrenfield tends to click once a second person is in it, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Want me to walk you through that next step this week?

Best,
Priya
